entities.name: Rev II of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rev II was a prince of Iberia of the Chosroid Dynasty who functioned as a co-king to his father Mirian III, the first Christian Georgian ruler and his mother was Nana of Iberia. Professor Cyril Toumanoff suggests the years 345–361 as the period of their joint reign.
